ashby:allium:9f81a9d7-8110-484e-bc0d-7f6.summary: Blockchain data is public. It is not usable at institutional scale. Despite being open, blockchain data is fragmented, hard to interpret, and painful to maintain. Even a simple question like “Who are the largest Ethereum token holders over time?” can require running nodes, ingesting full chain history, decoding contracts, cleaning edge cases, and writing complex SQL.

sections.title: The 4 biggest blockchain strengths are also its weakness
bullets: Permissionless nature leads to fragmentation of meaning
Decentralization leads to too many standards
Immutability leads to exponential data + query infrastructure complexity
Neutrality means that no one is accountable for interpretations

sections.title: Blockchains are optimized for writes, not reads.
paras: They are built for consensus and execution, not searchability, standardization, or financial interpretation. Blockchains are computers, not databases . Every protocol defines its own schema. The same economic action can be encoded in dozens of different ways. The result:
Finance cannot operate on that, it needs an effective system of record .
bullets: Fragmented standards
Exponential complexity
No accountability for interpretation
Events without economic meaning

sections.title: Allium is building the System of Record for Onchain Finance
paras: Allium ingests, verifies, and standardizes data across 140+ blockchains and 30+ petabytes of history. We close four structural gaps that prevent blockchains from becoming systems of record:
The result is a neutral, canonical data layer institutions can build on with confidence.
bullets: Semantic Gap: Translating raw events into financial concepts like payments, trades, deposits, and staking income
Standardization Gap: Mapping thousands of protocols into a single canonical cross chain schema
Infrastructure Gap: Read optimized, globally distributed data at web scale
Accountability Gap: Auditable methodology, SLAs, and SOC 1 and 2 compliance

sections.title: Finance is moving onchain
paras: Stablecoins, tokenized assets, trading, staking, and lending are growing rapidly. Institutions need a trusted source of truth for onchain financial activity, just as they rely on Bloomberg or DTCC in traditional markets. Raw blockchains cannot serve that role.

As AI agents begin transacting autonomously , the requirement becomes even stricter. Agents cannot reason over raw event logs. They need structured data, attribution, condition checks, and auditability.
Allium is the read layer that makes onchain finance usable for humans and machines.

ashby:hadrian-automation:ed0a5f63-d8b4-4.summary:

bullets: Own and evolve the product roadmap for the company. Decide which manufacturing and platform capabilities Hadrian builds next, in what order. Drive delivery across the business. Make the prioritization and resourcing calls when demands compete — the trade-offs and sequencing decisions that determine what gets done and what waits. Keep every team moving toward the same result. Individual teams own execution in their domain; you own that the business delivers as a whole.
Turn process into products. This team doesn't just set strategy and ship process — it builds products to do the work. For example, Nexus, Hadrian's internal tool for planning and execution tracking.

Take new products from zero to one. With visibility across the whole business, Global Product is often first to see where a net-new product or capability needs to exist — and takes it from zero to one : , building the case, shaping what it should be, and driving it into existence.

bullets: Technical depth in a core domain. Real technical expertise in at least one of Hadrian's core domains — advanced manufacturing, hardware, or technology — with the range and curiosity to build genuine fluency in the others. Strength across more than one is a major signal.
Systems-level thinking. You see across competing opportunities and constraints and understand how a decision in one area creates downstream consequences in others.

Product taste and judgment. You have a strong instinct for what's worth building — and what isn't. You can weigh customer demand, factory-floor reality, and where the company is headed, and make the call on where to point our effort.

A bias toward driving outcomes. You set strategy and own that it lands — building the plan, running the complex cross-functional effort, and keeping commitments from slipping. You make the hard prioritization calls when demands compete and you're comfortable saying no to protect what matters most.
Comfort working directly with customers. You can sit with enterprise customers on their hardest programs, scope what it will take, and translate what you hear into what our teams need to build.
Demonstrated leadership across complex systems. A track record of leading delivery across complex hardware and software systems.
Deep mission alignment. You care about the mission and are highly motivated to rebuild America’s industrial base.

ashby:headway:1069db3a-1043-454a-86f4-69.summary:

ashby:litmus:5dd5a528-7c2c-49eb-8096-1bf.summary:

ashby:numeric:d77a953b-cfae-4364-a6da-e8.summary:
Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP) , a platform built for the agent…

sections.title: Why Numeric
paras: We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.

sections.title: About the role
paras: If any of that resonates, this role is for you. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a book of Numeric customers and be accountable for their health: adoption, value, and renewal. In the AI era, the winner owns the financial data and the workflow. CS is how we make Numeric the system of record customers cannot rip out, recreate, or replace, and you're on the front line of that.

You'll be joining a team of reformed accountants, alumni of EY, PwC, KPMG, and Deloitte, plus in-house teams at companies like Brex, Meta, and WHOOP, who decided building the future of the close beat running one. We're also one of the most AI-forward post-sales teams in SaaS: we build our own AI agents and internal tooling rather than waiting for someone to build it for us.
bullets: Do you love being the person a controller calls before they call anyone else?
Ever wish you owned the whole customer relationship, not just the ticket in front of you?
Do you measure yourself by whether customers renew, adopt, and expand, not by how many meetings you ran?

sections.title: What You'll Do

Run an AI-leveraged cadence. Agents assemble your health signals, meeting prep, and follow-ups; you spend your hours on the judgment calls and relationships they can't make. Lead QBRs that connect Numeric to outcomes the customer's CFO cares about.
Build champions. Develop multi-threaded relationships from staff accountant to CAO, create referenceable customers, and drive case studies.
Detect and reverse risk. Build automated early-warning signals on your book, spot at-risk accounts before they surface on their own, and run save plays with the right internal resources.

Make your customers AI-native. Define what "adopted" means for each product and get customers there, including coaching controllers on running an AI-first close and connecting agents to their financials in Numeric.

AI Fluency & Bias for Action: You build systems where others repeat tasks. You use AI tools in your own daily workflow and expect your customers to as well.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to join the Technical Solutions team, the small team that keeps Omnea working for our customers every day. This role is based in New York. This is a customer-facing role with a technical problem-solving heart: when an integration breaks, a workflow misbehaves, or a customer needs Omnea to do something it doesn't do yet, you help find the root cause and the right solution. We resolve around 95% of what comes to us ourselves, from straightforward fixes to changes in production code and small feature requests. You'll be trusted to work out what's really wrong and see it through, drawing on the team's support when you need it.

You'll go deep on the product and broad on the problems: an integration misbehaving with a customer's ERP in the morning, a feature a customer has been asking for after lunch, and helping a colleague through a tough customer conversation by the end of the day. You'll be a trusted voice customers can turn to, joining their calls, providing clear answers and working closely with the Account Management team to set them up for long-term success with Omnea. AI helps us investigate faster, tracing logs, drafting hypotheses and suggesting fixes, but people own the outcome. You'll use your judgment, and the team's expertise where needed, to make sure solutions are safe for a live enterprise environment, address the root cause and surface patterns Product needs to hear about.

The CSE team sits between Customer, Product and Engineering. It's a small, close-knit team with a lot of autonomy, and the scope of the role grows as Omnea does. There is room to lean into your strengths, whether that's guiding customers towards solutions or bringing their feedback into the product, while building your technical skills. You'll develop deep knowledge of Omnea, and your work will be felt by customers every day.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Investigate the hard problems. One issue might be an integration failing with a customer's ERP, the next a workflow that isn't doing what anyone expected, the next a cross-system bug nobody else has cracked. You'll use AI to speed up the first pass, then confirm the cause and get it fixed.

Back up our Implementation and Customer teams. When a colleague hits a tricky configuration, an edge case or a question they can't answer, they come to you. You'll help them think it through, step into live implementations when they get technical, and make sure the customer gets the right answer.

Stay close to customers. You'll have ongoing calls with some customers, join QBRs and escalation calls, get brought in on specialist projects, and represent the Technical Solutions Team when customers move from implementation to ongoing support.

Bring the customer's voice into Product. You'll hear what customers struggle with before anyone else does. Spot the patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-argued input for Product, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

Make it scale. As we grow, we can't just add people. You'll build the tooling, automation, playbooks and docs that help customers solve more on their own and let the team handle more without slowing down.

sections.title: About You
paras: At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! bullets: You have at least 3 years of relevant experience, for example in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, software development or another technical, customer-facing role.

You want variety. You'd rather handle ten different problems than one big project.
You take ownership. You work independently, raise your hand for the hard problems, and see them through to resolution without needing the spotlight.

You care about customers, about getting it right, and about the team around you. You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after.
You explain technical issues clearly, whether you're talking to an engineer or a non-technical stakeholder.

paras: OpusClip is the world's #1 AI video agent for social media, used by 20M+ creators and businesses to turn raw footage into viral-ready clips. We're hiring an AI Product Manager , based in Mountain View , to own the core product roadmap that shapes how millions of creators experience OpusClip every day. Your job is to keep raising the bar on what our product can do and how good it feels, at the pace of a team that ships constantly.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own a Direction, Not a Backlog: Set the strategy for your surface, commit to the metrics it should move, and be the one accountable when they don't move.

Own the AI Quality Loop: Define what "good output" means for a generative feature, build the evaluation that measures it, and use that eval to decide what ships and what doesn't. On an AI product, taste alone isn't enough and a benchmark alone isn't either.
Be the Taste and Quality Bar: Act as the filter for what "good" looks like on a product used by millions. Every feature should feel considered, polished, and worth the user's trust.
Ship at Scale and Breadth: Run multiple feature workstreams in parallel without losing depth or craft. Know when to go deep on one feature and when to parallelize across several.

Codify a Repeatable Playbook: Turn your instincts into a method for how to scope, validate, and ship AI-powered features fast, and use it to raise the bar for the broader PM team, not just your own roadmap.

Partner Deeply with Engineering and Design: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with a high-caliber team to translate frontier AI capabilities (multimodal models, agents) into features creators reach for daily.

bullets: 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-usage features on a consumer or prosumer product

Deep, hands-on fluency with AI. You judge a model's real capability from your own testing rather than from its benchmark scores, and you can tell a model problem from a prompt problem from a product problem.

Comfort with evaluation. You've had to decide whether a generative output is good enough to ship when there was no obvious metric, and you built something repeatable to answer it rather than relying on vibes.

Goal-oriented and ruthless about priority. You work backward from the outcome you own, not the backlog. You can say why the top three things on your roadmap are the top three, and why everything else waits.
Ownership by default. You chase the loose ends nobody assigned to you, and you close the loop yourself: ship it, read the data, decide to iterate or kill it.
Defensible taste. You can name what is wrong with the products you admire most, not only what is good about them.
Experience building consumer-facing (B2C) products and a habit of direct user research
Based in the Bay Area and able to work on-site in Mountain View; comfortable partnering daily with our Shanghai and Vancouver teams across time zones

ashby:rho:3358396d-ae26-4e72-b41d-926a81.summary: Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

sections.title: The Role
paras: Rho is hiring Product Managers, but what we truly seek are GMs/Product CEOs. sections.title: What You'll Do
paras: Operate like a founder. Your surface is your company: its metrics are your P&L, its problems are yours whether or not they're in your job description. Nobody assigns founders their work. And build for them. Develop a deep, almost unfair understanding of how early-stage companies think about money, time, and risk. Design for the workflow they don't know they want yet — the desire path, not the paved one.

Own a problem space, not a problem. Not a feature, not a ticket queue — a living territory of customer problems that shift and collide. Frame the ones that matter, sharpen the hypothesis, define success before you build, and see it through to landing in a founder's hands. The map will change under you; redraw it and keep moving.

sections.title: Who You Are
paras: Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $165,000 - $320,000 . bullets: You have 3+ years building products — as a founder, PM, or engineer or equivalent experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment — and you've shipped work you're proud to put your name on.

You have frontier fluency. You work with AI daily — prototyping, analyzing, drafting, automating — and you can point to something you shipped or changed because a new capability made it possible. Not theorizing; doing.
You have taste. You hold your own view of what good looks like, obsess over the details, and know that in a banking product, every interaction carries trust.
You have discovery rigor. You can articulate the problem, the hypothesis, and how you'll know it worked before you've written a spec.
You build. You're not above opening a prototype, sketching a flow, or pulling the data yourself.

You think like a founder. You've been one, worked next to one, or operated like one — you take ownership past the edges of your role, and you pull things over the line that would die in someone else's backlog.
You're at home in ambiguity. You make calls on incomplete information and treat a pivot as new information, not a setback. Plans change; you're the steady one when they do.
You bring people with you. You build trust quickly, communicate proactively, and can align a room even when the answer is no.

ashby:sunday:f70e454e-b938-466e-be3f-e52.summary:
At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 2 years building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

Memo is the first home robot most of our users will ever live with. Everything he does — how he moves, what he says, how he sounds, what his lights mean, what the app tells you — makes an impression and builds or erodes trust. Human-robot interaction (HRI) is how we design all of that on purpose. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to HRI. You'll own Memo as a…

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own Memo's character. Turn the existing bio into a living character bible — personality, point of view, voice, what he likes, how he behaves under stress — that every team designs against.

Own the HRI roadmap across every product surface: robot motion and gestures, audio and voice, lighting, and app state and notifications. Decide what Memo communicates, when, and through which channel.
Define and maintain the HRI trigger set: for each robot state and event, specify the user-facing response across robot and app so engineering can build to it and QA can regression-test it.

Lead animation as a product area. Set briefs for animators, run reviews, and own the three objectives: legibility (a fresh-eyed user can predict what Memo's about to do), marketable moments (filmable, on-demand behaviors), and delight.
Own Memo's voice and sound: the voice itself, how it syncs with motion, conversational tone and register, and how voice interactions and playback feel in a real home.

Design how Memo interacts with people, kids, and pets — greetings, waiting, asking for help, finishing a task, being interrupted — in partnership with the Trust & Safety PM on stop conditions and recovery.
Learn from real homes. Watch beta families live with Memo, pull HRI feedback from dogfooding and betas, and turn it into requirements.
Partner with the behavior-stack and animation-pipeline engineers on what the system can express, and push for the tooling product needs to review and test animations.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: 4+ years in product, interaction design, or character/experience design on products people talk to, live with, or play with — consumer robots, voice assistants, games, animated characters, toys, smart home, wearables, or similar.

Nice to have a design background and portfolio. You've shaped how something looks, moves, sounds, or talks, and can show it. You don't need to be the animator or the sound designer, but you need to direct them well.
Fluency in character and personality design: how a point of view, movement style, and voice combine into something people recognize and care about.
Experience working across animation, sound, and UI on one coherent experience, and holding the line on consistency across surfaces.
Enough technical grounding to work with engineers on what a robot can physically and computationally express, and to make tradeoffs between ideal and feasible.
Strong user research instincts. You watch people, notice what they misread, and fix it.
Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a character bible that doesn't exist yet.
Bonus: robotics or physical product HRI experience; game or film character animation direction; voice/conversational design; work with TTS and motion-audio sync.

ashby:whippy:663c37f8-23b7-4da3-93e1-ea9.summary:

After the deal closes, you own the customer: you scope their problem, build the workflows, AI agents, and integrations that solve it, and grow the account from there.

This role is for someone with 5+ years of experience. You'll own a focused book of our largest and most complex accounts, where a single customer can be worth six figures in ARR and involve executives, recruiters, and operations teams across many branches.

sections.title: Why I'm hiring
paras: At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

sections.title: Some things you'll do
bullets: Design and build solutions in Whippy without engineering : workflows, AI voice and text agents, automations, and data syncs back into the customer's ATS.
Scope technical requirements with customers , translate them into a working build, and test and verify every piece before it goes live.
Own the customer after go-live , from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as their single point of contact and trusted technical advisor.
Run multi-stakeholder relationships across executives, recruiters, and operations teams at our largest customers, with account plans to match.
Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.
Own your gross and net revenue retention , and get rewarded for beating targets.
Tie usage to business outcomes , and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.
Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

sections.title: Our customer success values
paras: This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:
bullets: Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.
We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.
We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.
CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.
Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.
Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.
Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.
Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.
Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.
Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

5+ years in solutions engineering , sales engineering, technical consulting, or another technical customer-facing role, including leading complex technical rollouts for large customers. bamboohr:axomic:180.summary: We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Customer Success Org at OpenAsset. You'll work closely with our rapidly growing client base, specifically focused on early lifecycle clients who require 1:1, high touch support through the Onboarding and Adoption process in Year 1 of their client journey. The position is based out of our New York City office located near Bryant Park in Midtown Manhattan, and we're looking for local candidates who can join us in the office two days each week to collaborate with peers and build on our company culture. While this role is based in New York City, we are also open to considering strong candidates who are remote in the US and are able to work within the EST time zone.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: OpenAsset is the leading growth platform for the Architecture, Construction, and Engineering industries, trusted by 1,100+ clients over 20+ years. Our mission is to transform AEC workflows by connecting people, projects, and data so teams can capitalize on existing knowledge, act with clarity, and win more work with confidence. Our platform consists of Source, a digital asset management solution, and Shred , an AI proposal automation tool, with more solutions to come in 2027.

We’re a diverse, collaborative, and fast-growing team of 110+ employees with offices in New York, London, and Australia and a global client base. Backed by Marlin Equity Partners, we’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and has a voice, and we actively hire from a diverse pool of candidates.

As a CSM at OpenAsset, you will guide clients through the earliest and most critical stages of their lifecycle across our product suite, which includes OpenAsset Source and Shred . You will lead onboarding enablement, accelerate Time to Value (TTV), and establish a strong foundation for long-term adoption and retention. Working closely with Solution Architects (SAs) who own technical discovery, migrations, and integrations, you will ensure clients feel supported, prepared, and confident from the moment their journey begins. We have experience training people from the AEC industry without SaaS experience who are interested in a tech career, especially if you worked on proposals. All you need is a strong work ethic and desire to work directly with clients to solve pain points for AEC firms.
Own Client Enablement & Early Lifecycle Success
bullets: Serve as the primary strategic contact for new clients beginning at kickoff and continuing through onboarding, adopting, and early nurturing phases.
Drive a fast and predictable time-to-value (TTV) by establishing clear onboarding goals, milestones, and timelines.
Prepare clients for each onboarding stage by setting expectations, driving accountability, and ensuring readiness for data work, configuration steps, and training.
Lead training, change management, and best-practice guidance to support strong early adoption across both OpenAsset Source and Shred .
Create and manage onboarding success plans and supporting documentation focused on enablement, outcomes, and adoption (technical project plans remain owned by SAs).
Facilitate regular onboarding check-ins, track progress, manage risk, and maintain communication with all stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with client project managers, champions, and executive sponsors to ensure clarity and alignment throughout onboarding and beyond.
Provide clients with product guidance, workflow recommendations, and industry best practices tailored to AEC use cases across both OpenAsset Source and Shred .

bamboohr:ehr:173.summary:

EC Markets is an FCA-regulated FX and CFD brokerage. Our engineering team builds and runs our investing and trading app: a React Native / Expo app on iOS, Android and web, backed by a Java Spring Boot API on AWS that connects trading, custody, identity verification, payments and market-data platforms.

We are looking for a Product Owner to own the backlog for our investing and trading app and turn business, client and regulatory needs into well-defined work our engineers can deliver. You will work closely with the Engineering Lead and QA Lead, and with stakeholders across Trading, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations and Marketing.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Where a candidate sits within the band is determined by assessed experience against the role criteria, depth of product ownership on live consumer products and relevant financial-services and regulatory exposure. The same criteria apply to any later pay progression.
Our recruitment process is aligned with Directive (EU) 2023/970 on pay transparency and equal pay:

Process at a glance: CV screen → Talent Acquisition conversation (30 min, incl. salary band) → interview with the Head of Product and Head of Technology (60 min) → case exercise: prioritise a backlog and write stories with acceptance criteria, presented to a panel (90 min) → offer. Typical end-to-end timeline: 3–4 weeks. Reasonable adjustments are available at any stage; just let us know.

EC Markets is an equal-opportunities employer. We make hiring decisions on the basis of skills, experience and demonstrated potential, and do not discriminate on the grounds of sex, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital or civil-partnership status, pregnancy or parental status, or trade-union membership.
bullets: Own and prioritise the product backlog against client value, regulatory obligations, risk and delivery capacity.
Turn business needs into clear epics and user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
Contribute to the product roadmap and keep it current and visible to the business.
Lead backlog refinement and set sprint goals; accept completed work.
Work with the Engineering Lead and QA Lead on scope, trade-offs and release readiness.
Give every epic a clear owner and exit criteria.
Run business acceptance testing and sign-off with the teams that raised the requirement.
Build regulatory requirements into the product with Compliance, including FCA Consumer Duty, client money and KYC / AML.

bamboohr:lji:199.summary:
Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue-generating growth engines.
Built as an AI-first, next-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: We are hiring a high-energy, data-driven Enterprise Account Director to spearhead LJI’s growth within the APAC region.

As a key member of our enterprise sales team, you will be responsible for achieving sales targets by selling GRAVTY® solutions to LJI’s enterprise customers / "ecosystem-centric" industries where customer frequency and high transaction volumes are key. You will guide enterprises from their first interaction through to a successful launch, helping them realize the full transformative value of GRAVTY®.

This is a strategic role for a "Challenger" sales leader who excels at building long-term C-suite relationships, navigating complex organizational structures, and driving large-scale digital transformation.
bullets: 400+ Million members connected through our platform.
100+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
3-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
Recognized as a ‘Strong Performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025.

Strategic Visioning: Define and execute a well-defined sales strategy and roadmap for your accounts/territory to achieve your sales objectives and targets. This involves analysing market trends, competitor analysis, identifying growth opportunities, pipeline creation etc.
C-Suite Engagement: Build and maintain deep-rooted relationships with CIOs/CTOs/CMOs/ CXOs, acting as a trusted advisor on loyalty and tech-driven engagement.
Complex Problem Solving: Solve unique customer challenges with resilience, using GRAVTY®’s flexible architecture to deliver bespoke value.

bamboohr:nexgentechnologies:153.summary:
If you have Virtual Office and or Contact Center experience, we have the perfect position for you.

Are you Customer Service focused? Are you detail-oriented and like technology? Are you looking for growth opportunities while working remote? You’ve found it at NexGen!

We are seeking a dedicated SaaS Customer Success Manager to join our team.

NexGen Technologies (NGT) has launched a new generation of customer contact management solutions, services, and technologies. NGT provides a new level of customer-centric services/technologies across all interactions in existing and emerging markets, specifically targeting the rapidly growing digital real estate market.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The Customer Success Manager (CSM) directly engages with assigned customers to provide management of all support related functions. This role requires the ability to provide customers with the best attention and solutions possible, and to function in technical capacities. The candidate will need a solid understanding of NexGen products and services.

The main function will be to receive incoming communication (email, calls, support tickets) from our BPO clients and Virtual Office subscriptions and provide a solution to set our customers at ease. The CSM will work with other organizations to onboard new customers, train customers and keep them happy during the lifetime of our partnership with them. The CSM is the primary point of contact for all customers. They will ensure that Support Service Levels are met and provide regular reporting of Support performance metrics to the customer. They will also be the conduit for any upsell opportunities and bring them into a sales engagement.
Salary $50,000 + commission (on upsells and SLA achievements)
bullets: The role involves managing our customers’ experience, guiding them towards successful use of our software, and helping them achieve their objectives.
Our ideal candidate should be skilled at managing customer relationships, understanding their needs and requirements, and implementing strategies to drive customer retention and satisfaction.
Develop customer relationships that promote retention and loyalty.
Work closely with customers to ensure they are satisfied with the services they receive and to improve upon areas of dissatisfaction.
Provide technical support to customers with the help of the support team.
Manage and solve conflicts with clients.
Interact and coordinate with the sales team and other staff members in other departments working on the same account.
Understand our company’s products and services and be able to present them to customers.

bamboohr:satellogic:593.summary:
Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers.

We build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving us the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Our technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence.

With a team distributed across five countries, Satellogic brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

Customer Success is a team of highly skilled Remote Sensing Engineers and Geospatial Intelligence Analysts, with vast experience in the defense, public and private sectors. We think of customers as partners. We aim for a deep understanding of their use cases, processes and jobs-to-be-done. Their success is ours. We find the best solutions, ensure that we deliver to our commitments and that this generates both revenue and lasting relationships for us, and real value for our customers.

We are looking for a dynamic Account Manager to drive our Asia-Pacific business to growth and our customers to success. With our cutting-edge constellation of satellites delivering real-time insights to clients across the defense, intelligence, and civilian agency world and our industry partners, we’re redefining how the world sees itself—and you’ll be front and center, leading the charge.
bullets: Manage and grow relationships with key APAC clients, commercial partners, and primes.
Be the go-to for customers—listening, strategizing, and aligning Satellogic’s Products and Solutions with their needs, all while pushing boundaries and exceeding goals.

Onboard customers and bring a technical savvy to the job. We want the soft skills, and for you to bring your hard geospatial skills to bear as well, getting your hands dirty and being an every-day-user of our Products and technology.
Oversee the healthy execution of our Data & Analytics line of business agreements, while looking for opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, throughout the entire customer lifecycle.
Team up with our globally dispersed crew of Product managers, Sales professionals and R&D Engineers to streamline our efforts towards delivering high value and repeatable products and solutions.
Identify opportunities to expand our reach and footprint with government agencies, commercial players, and prime contractors.
Hit the road (up to 25% travel) to meet clients, partners, and teammates—building trust face-to-face and soaking in the bigger picture.
A solid professional with 5+ years of experience working within government earth observation, remote sensing or ISR, government account management or on an accounts team.

bamboohr:simpligov:118.summary:
Must be a commutable distance to Tallahassee, Florida to be considered.

SimpliGov is the government operations platform where state and local agencies design, run, and improve how their programs operate. We help agency teams move applications, approvals, signatures, and payments across systems and departments, without waiting on IT backlogs, long transformation projects, or outside consultants.

Our work puts the people who know the programs best in control of how the work gets done. We value simplicity, ownership, and results, and we are committed to helping government teams deliver reliable, better run programs for the constituents who depend on them.

paras: The Professional Services Manager leads a team within Professional Services, Analysts or Project Managers, overseeing that team's day-to-day responsibilities and quality across implementations. Own the quality and day-to-day execution of everything your team delivers
Keep the team's workload prioritized, capacity planned, and standards compliant
Mentor team members and coach them toward their next level

Team up with fellow Managers to keep project assignments balanced across the practice

bamboohr:truecontext:52.summary:
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers. You’ll learn how their field operations really run and where TrueContext can make them better, then help them get there. You’ll be their strategic advisor and their most knowledgeable guide to the platform. Inside TrueContext, you’ll be their strongest voice.

When a hospital's imaging system goes down, patients wait for answers. When a substation fails, a neighborhood loses power. When an inspection is missed in a building’s fire system, people are at risk. A skilled field engineer stands behind each of those moments. Their work keeps hospitals, cities and energy systems running, and most of it goes unseen.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: TrueContext is the Field Intelligence platform built for those engineers. Leading companies in medical technology, utilities, energy and building systems use us to guide their teams through complex work and capture what happens at every asset. That knowledge then turns into better decisions. Each visit makes the next one faster, safer and smarter.

We’re early in a big shift. Customers have known us as the tool that digitized their forms, and we’re becoming the platform that makes field work intelligent. Our Customer Success team guides customers through that change, and it’s a chance to help define a category while it’s still taking shape.

Your customers use more of the platform, in more parts of their business, and can point to results in their own numbers. They see you as part of their team. Renewals and growth follow from that work. You’ll be assessed on the customer value you deliver, measured through feature adoption, product utilization, and gross and net revenue retention.

You’ll join a company of about 100 people at a turning point, where your work is visible and your input changes what we build. You’ll work with customers whose work matters, on a platform that’s adding AI and intelligence to some of the most demanding jobs in the field.
bullets: Understand the business behind the work. Learn each customer’s field workflows, assets and goals well enough to see opportunities they haven’t spotted yet.
Drive adoption that changes outcomes. Bring the right capabilities into the right workflows and expand to new teams and sites. Help customers move from capturing data to acting on it.
Build customer self-sufficiency. Turn admins and builders into confident power users who can carry the platform forward and keep it running when people change roles.

Make the impact visible. Agree on success with each customer using metrics they already track, such as first-time fix rate, compliance or time to invoice. Measure progress and share it with their leadership in regular business reviews.
Make every conversation useful. Bring something to each one: a fix, an idea, an insight from their own data.
Find what’s next. Spot the next workflow, team or site where we can help, and work with your Account Manager to turn it into growth.
Build relationships across the organization, from engineers in the field to the operations leaders setting priorities.
Be the customer’s voice inside TrueContext. Bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering and help shape what we build next.

greenhouse:abinbev:8586652002.summary: AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

sections.title: About AB InBev Growth Group
paras: Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets:
Define and Advance ML Platform Strategy


• Set the vision and roadmap for your platform domain, prioritizing self-service, reliability, and reusability across the ML lifecycle.
Define and evolve standards, contracts, and shared tooling that enable scalable adoption of platform capabilities.

Drive Adoption and Platform Delivery


• Partner closely with data science, ML engineering, and data engineering teams to identify workflow bottlenecks and platform gaps.
Deliver capabilities such as templates, CLIs, and standardized workflows, enabling users to execute repeatable tasks independently within clear guardrails.

Enable Scalable Machine Learning Operations


• Improve and standardize how models move from development to production, reducing manual effort and increasing reliability.
Ensure platform capabilities provide clear ownership, consistent practices, and strong operational visibility.
Drive adoption of shared platform components across multiple data science teams and markets.

Relevant years of professional experience with a strong technical foundation
Hands-on experience as a data scientist, machine learning engineer, or software engineer is strongly preferred
Experience working on complex, cross-functional technical problems involving data and platform systems

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience defining and prioritizing a roadmap, backlog, or release plan.
Comfort writing clear requirements, user stories, or acceptance criteria that engineering teams can execute against.

greenhouse:altanaai:8207712003.summary: Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

sections.title: The Opportunity at Altana
paras:
This is a business development role in Altana's Resilience & Network vertical. It's a chance to build a business, not just join one. You'll lead Altana's growth with the Department of War (DoW), establishing DoW as the anchor of a trusted network with the defense industrial base (DIB) so government and industry can collaborate on a shared, secure view of the supply chains defense depends on.

You'll build trusted relationships with senior DoW officials, program offices, and acquisition leaders, acting as a thought partner who helps them move through technology transformation. Your focus: generating DoW opportunities that change how the department works with its industrial base. You'll work hand in hand with Altana's enterprise team, which leads our work with DIB companies, so both sides of the network grow together. Success in this role comes from curiosity, judgment, integrity, long-term thinking, and the ability to lead through inspiration.

For the right operator, this is the most ambitious and rewarding work of a career. Altana has a deep, engaged global network of customers, champions, and partners — you'll activate and expand it across the DIB and DoW, and help define how industry and government collaborate on defense.

sections.title: You Will
bullets: Own a portfolio of strategic DoW accounts, translating the vertical's strategy into a focused plan for each.

Shape new opportunities by communicating Altana's value to senior government and industry stakeholders, and partnering with DoW program offices as they design how they will work with industry on the network.

Pursue complex, large-scale programs, building a pipeline that reflects strategic vision rather than a quota, and charting the path from prototype funding (OTAs, CSOs, SBIR/STTR, TACFI/STRATFI) to programs of record and enduring contract vehicles such as IDIQs.

Collaborate closely with Altana's enterprise team, which owns relationships with primes, manufacturers, and suppliers, to align DoW and DIB pursuits and connect DoW customers with their industry counterparts on the network.
Anticipate what each pursuit will require and surface those needs internally early, coordinating across teams you don't directly control.
Partner closely with the Head of Resilience and the VP of Global Public Sector, and work with Capture on bid/no-bid, teaming, and proposal strategy.
Run effective discovery and partner with Solution Architects, Product, and Engineering to craft solutions and surface use cases early.
Become fluent in defense industrial base policy, sourcing rules, and the competitive landscape, and act as the voice of the defense customer internally.

sections.title: You Have
paras: This role is based in Washington, DC with hybrid work flexibility.
bullets: A defense background is required: significant experience in the defense sector, whether in uniform, in government acquisition, or in industry, including business development, capture, or acquisition work, and a track record of opening markets and shaping large, strategic deals.

Working knowledge of the defense industrial base and how DoW and industry work together, including domestic sourcing and compliance requirements (NDAA and DFARS sourcing rules, FOCI, provenance). Critical minerals, microelectronics, or unmanned systems experience a plus.
Deep understanding of government contracting, requirements, and budgeting, especially moving prototypes into production through OTAs and onto program-of-record vehicles such as IDIQs.
A network across DoW program offices, acquisition leaders, and industrial base policy stakeholders that you can activate.
A builder's instinct: you've led complex efforts, you operate effectively through influence, and you're energized by standing up something new rather than inheriting it.
Excellent judgment and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders independently and translate complex value into a clear case.
Comfort with software tools; familiarity with modern AI tools a plus.
A hunter's mindset paired with the patience and optimism to prevail in long government procurement cycles.

greenhouse:authenticinsurance:4483217009.summary: Authentic is a tech-enabled MGA (managing general agent). We design and run insurance programs for specific kinds of businesses, like restaurants, gyms, and power producers. Brokers bring us the businesses that need coverage, and carriers back our policies. Every program runs on a platform we built ourselves, and we own every line of code behind it. Engineers and insurance experts build it side by side in New York and Dayton, Ohio. Since our founding in 2022, we’ve grown to 80+ people and been named to the 2026 CB Insights Insurtech 50.

You'll work closely with Agent Support, Underwriting, Billing and Platform Support, and you'll help make our processes, help content and AI better over time.

Customer support and escalations

greenhouse:avomdincdbaavo:4292122009.summary:
Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.

We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.

sections.title: The Role
paras: Avo is hiring a Senior Director of Product to lead product strategy and execution across our platform. This is a leadership role and the ideal candidate will work with our CPO to refine, and operationalize Avo's product vision, driving roadmap decisions that accelerate customer value and long-term platform differentiation. You’ll work directly with our Engineering, Product, Clinical , Customer, and Commercial teams to shape what we build and ship fast.

You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.

Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation

Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.

Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead

Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly

greenhouse:okta:8137951.summary:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As Senior Product Manager, Policies, you own product strategy and execution for Okta's authentication policy roadmap. The Policies team owns how Okta evaluates risk and context to decide when, how, and whether a user, machine, or agentic identity is allowed to authenticate and stay authenticated. This includes Application Sign-On Policy, Global Session Policy, Okta Account Management Policy (OAMP), and Device Signal Collection Policy as well as the underlying Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that power them.

Policies is foundational to the entire Okta product portfolio as it's the decision layer that sits between every authentication event and the security experience a customer wants for their end users. You'll work closely with engineering, design, other product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Okta's platform to ensure policy capabilities evolve strategically, including how policy changes are rolled out and managed at scale (change management / identity operations).

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own roadmap and prioritization for your product area, balancing customer requests, platform needs, and market/strategic differentiation
Collaborate with design and engineering to define, scope, and ship policies that have best-in-class user experience while meeting the security needs of Okta customers
Drive product direction for the Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that underpin every policy evaluation across Okta
Define how policy changes are managed operationally — versioning, staged rollout, auditability, and rollback — as part of a broader change management and identity operations strategy
Work directly with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and other product teams to understand policy needs and translate them into product requirements
Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, and rapid prototyping to drive roadmap alignment and execution
Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including engineering, field teams, tech partnerships, and marketing, to ensure successful launch and adoption of policy-related experiences

Serve as the subject matter expert, representing Policies in customer escalations, executive briefings, and enterprise prospect evaluations, as well as partnerships with Marketing and GTM counterparts

sections.title: What You Bring to Okta
bullets: 6+ years experience in product management
Experience in identity, security, enterprise-scale, platform, or developer products
Ability to have in-depth technical discussions with engineering teams
Ability to connect platform-level decisions to Okta's broader business outcomes and market position as a technology leader
Ability to empathize and dig deeper into customer problems and needs before designing solutions
Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable flexing between spec-level detail and executive narrative
Entrepreneurial and ownership mindset - given an ambiguous problem, you decide what matters, decide what to do about it, and drive it forward

Collaborative by default - you strive to earn trust with customers, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders. Your default is to bring people in early and often to inform a blended, stronger direction

Trier, gérer et assurer le suivi jusqu'à leur résolution des signalements de bogues et des problèmes techniques soumis par les éditeurs.

Prismatic is the integration platform that helps B2B software companies build integrations fast and deliver them at scale. We're turning integrations from a bottleneck into a growth driver for hundreds of companies, from high-growth startups to Fortune 500s.

Our platform handles everything that breaks at scale, so teams can ship integrations, not infrastructure. It provides flexible, AI-enabled build experiences through code-native, low-code, and an embedded workflow builder, plus self-service configuration and an embedded marketplace.

sections.title: About the role:
paras: As a Technical Account Manager, you own the ongoing technical success of a named set of customers. You understand what they are building, why it matters to their business, and how Prismatic fits into their product and architecture. You help new work achieve its goals and keep existing integrations operating reliably as their needs evolve.

You build relationships with the engineering and product leaders who guide the work and the developers who deliver it. From initial implementation through production adoption, new use cases, and technical challenges, you turn customer priorities into a clear plan and stay accountable for moving it forward. You bring recommendations to the customer, help their team make sound technical decisions, and involve the right Prismatic specialists when needed.
You partner with an Account Manager who owns the commercial relationship, aligning technical priorities and progress with the customer's business goals.

sections.title: You Will...
bullets: Know your accounts. Understand each customer's software business: who they serve, how their product creates value, and what is driving their roadmap. Connect that context to their integration priorities, architecture, and technical stakeholders so your recommendations support their product and business goals.

Own the technical relationship. Lead regular technical conversations with customer builders and the people directing their work. Come prepared with relevant recommendations, questions, and next steps based on their priorities and how they use Prismatic.

Build customer capability. Identify where customer teams need guidance, provide practical advice, and organize focused working sessions with the right technical experts. Follow through until customers can apply that guidance and build and operate effectively.

Improve how customers operate. Use adoption data, integration performance, support history, and customer feedback to identify risks and opportunities. Recommend improvements to reliability, usage, and cost, and follow through to confirm the results.

Lead technical escalations. Establish the problem, customer impact, and recovery plan; coordinate Support, architecture specialists, Product, and Engineering; and follow through until recovery is verified. Keep the customer and Account Manager informed of progress, risks, and next steps.
Participate in the on-call rotation. Triage critical customer incidents, coordinate with Engineering, and own customer communication.

Help customers adopt what comes next. Identify relevant capabilities and use cases and connect them to the customer's priorities. Bring in Solution Engineering for demos and technical selling, supply the account context they need, and carry resulting technical commitments into the customer's plan.

Make the account team effective. Maintain clear architecture notes and action plans, prepare specialists with the context they need, and bring customer evidence to Product and Engineering to improve the platform.

sections.title: You might be a good fit if you...
bullets: Have 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role in B2B SaaS, such as technical account management, implementation engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, or technical support with ongoing account responsibility.

Understand how software businesses grow and how product teams prioritize roadmaps, balance customer needs with engineering capacity, and make build-versus-buy decisions. Can explain how integrations support a customer's product strategy, customer adoption, and growth.

Have a strong technical foundation in production integrations, including REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, asynchronous processing, error handling, and rate limits. Can use technical documentation, logs, and code examples to understand behavior and investigate an issue.
Can connect a customer's product goals to technical requirements, discuss architecture tradeoffs, and work with specialists to evaluate proposed solutions.
Build credibility with engineers and product leaders, ask useful questions, and recommend a path forward when requirements are incomplete or priorities change.
Have independently managed ongoing technical relationships across multiple customers, prioritized competing needs, and driven work across teams to measurable results.
Take initiative to identify adoption gaps, operational risks, and useful next steps, and can explain why they deserve attention.
Communicate clearly in writing and conversation, adapt to your audience, and give teammates enough context to act.

Software development experience, particularly TypeScript/JavaScript, or experience with GraphQL, CI/CD, multi-tenant systems, integration observability, and cost optimization.
Experience helping customers adopt AI agent tooling, MCP, or new integration capabilities.

greenhouse:pushpay:8384583.summary: Pushpay exists to serve the Church. We build software that helps faith communities manage generosity, connect members, and focus on what matters most: ministry. As we deepen our commitment to the churches we serve, we are looking for a Senior Product Manager who brings world-class product craft and an authentic understanding of how church life actually runs, someone who sees this work as more than a job.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Our core church portfolio is where most of our customers live, and the value they get from it is the heart of our business. As Senior Product Manager, Faith & Strategy, you will make sure that value is real.

You will be pointed at the highest-impact opportunities across the portfolio, and your focus will shift as our priorities do. One season it might be a workflow churches struggle to adopt. The next, a part of the product where satisfaction is slipping. You will ship the work that moves those outcomes, and you will leave the team better at it than you found them.

This role is for someone who is a church operations expert and a product leader at once. You can walk into an unfamiliar area, find what matters, build the case, and ship it. Success is not about controlling a roadmap. It is about earning the trust and building the clarity of argument that gets the right work shipped, and keep the real needs of churches at the center of decisions made by teams with broader mandates.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Ship Where the Value Is: Take ownership of high-priority problems and opportunities across the portfolio, from discovery through launch and adoption. Ramp quickly in new workflow areas, form a point of view in weeks, and get product into customers’ hands.

Be the Voice of the Church: Apply deep knowledge of church operations to product decisions from day one. Use targeted discovery with pastors, administrators, and volunteer leaders to validate direction and surface nuance across church size, governance, weekly rhythms, and seasons.
Read the Signals: Watch adoption, retention, NPS, and CSat across the portfolio. Spot trends before they show up as churn, turn them into clear recommendations, and help teams act on them.

Set the Standard for PM Craft: Model strong product habits: sharp problem statements, outcome-based success measures, honest retros. Coach other PMs and share what works, so how we decide and deliver keeps getting better.

Navigate and Influence the Portfolio: Work across product domains, Engineering, and UX to make sure church needs are understood, prioritized, and delivered, including where AI can reduce friction or surface insight. Build trust, make the business case, and know when to escalate.

Responsible AI: Champion a “Human-in-the-Loop” approach that reduces administrative burden without replacing pastoral judgment or the personal relationships at the heart of church life. Ensure every AI feature honors the privacy and trust churches place in us.

Market Advocacy: Help Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing explain Pushpay’s value in language that resonates with pastors and church administrators. Show up at key church conferences and customer events as a credible product voice.

sections.title: How We'll Measure Success
bullets: Product Shipped & Adopted: Meaningful product delivered in each area you’re assigned, with clear, measurable results defined up front and reported honestly.
Adoption & Retention: Growth in the share of accounts actively using delivered features, with churn as the lagging indicator of real value.
Satisfaction: Measurable improvement in NPS and CSat where you’ve focused.
Insight to Action: Trends you surfaced that changed a roadmap or a decision.
Time Savings: Quantified reduction in time-on-task for church staff using delivered features.
PM Craft: Visible improvement in shared practices and in the PMs you coach.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: Church Operations Fluency (Required): Ministry from the inside, through church staff or volunteer leadership, or product work on church or ministry software. You understand how churches staff, volunteer, communicate, and steward resources. A personal connection to or deep respect for the Church is essential.
Range and Fast Ramp: You get fluent in a new domain quickly, and you’re energized, not rattled, when priorities shift.
Influence Without Authority: You drive outcomes across teams you don’t control, through expertise and trust, not org chart position.
Data-Driven Judgment: You turn adoption and satisfaction data into decisions, and you know when the numbers need a conversation with a customer to explain them.
AI Product Fluency: You know what AI can and cannot do in a ministry context, can define requirements for LLM-based features, and recognize when a human touch matters more than automation.
Operational & Technical Fluency: Comfortable with APIs and integrations. You understand why being the source of truth for church data matters.
Communication That Moves People: Clear point of view. Adapts on evidence. Doesn’t hedge.

sections.title: You Will:

Drive the evolution of our Compute infrastructure to support Roblox’s most critical workloads - from AI to Storage to Data Analytics and more - each with their own distinct requirements.
Build and scale our GPU infrastructure to support training and inference for frontier models, enabling innovation at scale while optimizing cost-to-serve.
Stay laser-focused on Compute Platform Reliability for AI and other Roblox workloads, lowering mean-time-to-detection and recovery from failures.
Partner closely with seven key platform teams to understand their use cases and empower them with Compute Platform primitives enabling them to build on top easily.

greenhouse:samsara:8353150.summary: Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

sections.title: Total Rewards
paras: At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. greenhouse:undercontrolroboticsinc:44563.summary: Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

sections.title: Position Overview
paras: We're looking for an exceptional Customer Success & Deployment Leader to build and lead the organization that takes Noble Machines' general-purpose robots from signed contract to dependable, everyday operation at customer sites. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you'll own customer outcomes from the first pilot through fleet scale-up, renewal, and expansion, and you'll be the bridge between our customers and Noble Machines' engineering, autonomy, product, and service teams. You'll make sure our robots show up ready for the realities of construction, mining, and energy sites - and that they keep delivering value long after they arrive.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Build the organization. Build and lead a team of deployment program managers, field and application engineers, and customer success managers, scaling the team and its leadership as Noble Machines grows.
Own deployments end-to-end. Take full ownership from site assessment and task scoping through validation in Sunnyvale, on-site integration, commissioning, and hand-off to steady-state operations.

Set deployment readiness standards. Define the safety, reliability, uptime, and performance criteria a robot must meet before it goes to a customer site—including readiness for dust, vibration, temperature extremes, and the unpredictable conditions of heavy-industry work.

Run a repeatable playbook. Standardize how Noble Machines deploys: pilot-to-production gates, simulation and test validation, integration with customer site operations and safety programs, and change management and training for frontline crews working alongside our robots.

Deliver and prove value. Track and report robot uptime, task throughput, time-to-productivity, intervention rate, hazardous-exposure hours removed from workers, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention.

Close the loop with engineering. Channel field data, failure modes, and customer requirements back to Noble Machines' engineering and product teams to shape the roadmap and improve reliability in the field.
Manage executive relationships. Serve as the senior point of contact for customers' operations, safety, and site leadership; lead executive business reviews and own escalations.
Work with partners. Coordinate with contractors, site operators, integrators, and service partners to keep deployments on schedule and on spec.

sections.title: Requirements
bullets: 12+ years in customer success, professional services, field engineering, or deployment leadership, with at least 5 years in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or complex hardware-plus-software products.
Proven experience moving robotic or autonomous hardware out of R&D and into commercial production at external customer sites.
Experience building and leading distributed, field-based teams.
Working knowledge of robot autonomy, simulation and sim-to-real validation, and industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ANSI/A3 R15.06).
Strong commercial sense, including renewals, expansion, services pricing, and deployment P&L.
Executive presence and credibility with senior customer leaders, from site superintendents to the C-suite.
Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, including active construction, mining, and energy job sites.

Background in engineering or computer science; an MBA is a plus.
Familiarity with jobsite safety programs and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
Experience scaling a customer-facing organization at an early-stage hardware company.

Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

The strategy and the technical foundation are built; we need solution designers who can execute it and scale it across customers.

There has never been a better moment to sit at the frontier of agentic AI for manufacturing. We are assembling a small team of operators to capture it, and this role helps define what “great” looks like.

sections.title: The Role
paras: The AI Sales Solutions Engineer is a solution designer. You walk into a customer conversation, understand their end-to-end process, and assemble an agentic solution to fix it — without engineering involvement.

You sit on top of a pre-built foundation — data, semantics, an agent platform, and a library of persona agents. You configure within it; you don’t build it. The platform exposes configuration through natural language and drag-and-drop, so your edge is domain fluency and solution-design instinct, not code.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
paras: Working hand-in-hand with other Account Executives, you take a qualified opportunity and turn it into a working agentic solution:
bullets: Run process discovery workshops: sit with champion users to map any of the standard enterprise processes (P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R) — current state, KPIs, manual effort, bottlenecks, and target state.

Design the agentic solution: decide which agents, working together, fix the customer’s process — and recognize whether it’s a greenfield build or a brownfield plug-in to an existing system (SAP, Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer).
Map KPIs to the platform: confirm the system has the data and the business context to measure what the customer actually cares about.
Configure each agent: set triggers, decision logic, exceptions, KPIs, data sources, communications, company-specific rules, and hand-offs — all in natural language and drag-and-drop, no code.
Present the solution: pitch anchored in business outcomes — OTIF, working capital, cycle time, cost reduction — worked backwards to the agents that achieve them.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: You are a quota carrier with 3 or more years of experience selling Tech/AI/SaaS solutions.

Enterprise domain fluency: operational, end-to-end working knowledge of at least two of P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R — not just a consulting view. The deepest value sits in plan-to-make and procure-to-pay.
Solution-design thinking: ability to decompose a vague business outcome into agents and data flows, and to know when one agent suffices and when several are needed.
Low-code / natural-language comfort: hands-on with tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make. The agent platform will feel familiar.
Customer-facing credibility: workshop facilitation and executive-level presentation.

sections.title: Nice-to-Have
paras: Model-building, software-engineering depth, or an ML / data-science background. Engineering owns the platform; you own the solution.
bullets: Background at a major ERP vendor or process consultancy (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba, or a Big Four firm).
Hands-on experience with AI tooling.
Industry depth in manufacturing, particularly tier-one suppliers.
